</font><font style="color:#0000ff;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">investor_relations&#64;edwards.com</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">EDWARDS COMMENTS ON JENAVALVE ACQUISITION</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:150%">IRVINE, Calif., January 9, 2026</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%"> &#8211; Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE&#58; EW) today announced that the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia has granted the motion from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) for an injunction blocking the company&#8217;s proposed acquisition of JenaValve Technology. As a result, Edwards will not acquire JenaValve.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%">Edwards disagrees with the decision and believes that the acquisition would have been in the best interest of a large, growing and underserved group of patients. </font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%">Aortic regurgitation (AR) is a deadly, progressive disease. It is typically under-detected and under-referred and carries very high mortality if left untreated. As a company pioneering first-of-its-kind innovations for unaddressed structural heart patient groups, Edwards remains committed to leading the AR therapy for patients in need. The company will continue to deliver novel therapies and world-class evidence to transform patient care</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%">, including advancing the SOJOURN transcatheter AR valve and enrolling patients in the JOURNEY pivotal trial.</font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%">In light of this update, Edwards is revising its full-year 2026 adjusted</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%"> EPS guidance to $2.90 &#8211; $3.05 from earlier guidance of $2.80 &#8211; $2.95. Any additional updates will be provided at the Fourth Quarter Earnings Call in February.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">About Edwards Lifesciences</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Edwards Lifesciences is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives. Through breakthrough technologies, world-class evidence and partnerships with clinicians and healthcare stakeholders, our employees are inspired by our patient-focused culture to deliver life-changing innovations to those who need them most. Discover more at www.edwards.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Forward Looking Statements </font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">This news release includes forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. </font><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">We intend the forward-looking statements contained in this release to be covered by the safe harbor provisions of such Acts. </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">These forward-looking statements can sometimes be identified by the use of forward-looking words, such as &#8220;may,&#8221;
